_comment: S11 capacités-extraction — modules.route (in-core route capability). Endpoint decorator: derives start/end markers from the line features of a bound layer. Opt-in PER LAYER (config.layers only — never all polylines). Bound to the trail layer `parcours` (Randonnée/Vélo) where a départ/arrivée makes sense; NOT to `routes_principales` (road network, where per-segment endpoints are meaningless). The line itself is rendered by the generic GeoJSON engine; the capability only styles the endpoints.
